events.title: Kids Eat Free
events.location: Coolangatta Surf Club, 61 Marine Parade, Coolangatta, QLD, 4225
events.description: Kids Eat Free from 5pm - Tuesdays    Every Tuesday from 5pm.    Kids eat free with any main meal purchased.    One nippers meal per main meal ordered (excludes breads, sides, snack, start & share & seniors meals).    T&C's apply. Child must be present. No takeaway. Members only.

events.title: Wednesday Schnitzel Night
events.location: Coolangatta Surf Club, 61 Marine Parade, Coolangatta, QLD, 4225
events.description: WEDNESDAYS FROM 5PM  Midweek dinners just got sorted 🙌  Join us every Wednesday at Cooly Surf Club for Schnitzel Night! Tuck into a 250g chicken breast schnitzel served with crispy chips and fresh salad for only $17.50.  Feeling extra hungry? Level it up with a classic parmi or a tasty garlic prawn topper for just $5 more.  Exclusive to members only. Not a member yet? It’s easy — sign up at reception when you arrive.

events.title: Wednesday Night Members Draw + Community Raffles
events.location: Coolangatta Surf Club, 61 Marine Parade, Coolangatta, QLD, 4225
events.description: WEDNESDAYS FROM 6PM  Fall more in love with your local right here at Cooly Surf Club! Don't miss our Wednesday Night Members Draw!     Join us at the club every Wednesday for your chance to win up to $5,000!   Draws will take place every Wednesday at 6:15pm and 7:15pm. No winnner? There's a $200 consolation prize drawn at 7:30pm.     Jackpot starts at $2,000 & increases by $200 weekly!   $200 consolation prize weekly    While you're here, we're also running our weekly Community Raffles, with prizes up for grabs each week!     Community Raffles | Raffle drawn from 7PM   Tickets on sale from 6pm | $2 for 10 numbers    The proceeds of our community raffles will go to a local charity, not-for-profit or community group. Join our community & nominate your organisation or community group to become a beneficiary of the monthly raffle sales.     The March 2026 Community Raffles Beneficiary is the Cooly2Molokai Paddle Group.    Cooly2Molokai is a Grassroots prone paddling group, born on Coolangatta Beach. What started as two friends picking up a new sport, has turned into a group that supports our local paddlers achieve their wildest dreams, training together, racing together, and experiencing the ocean on a whole new level. A shared love of the power and beauty of the ocean, healthy competition, and commitment to the paddling community saw Cooly2Molokai born. The group provides a support system for paddlers attempting to cross the Channel of Bones, through training together, encouraging team bonding through involvement in volunteer movements such as Surf Life Saving, and logistical and financial assistance for our paddlers.

events.title: Thursday Steak Night
events.location: Coolangatta Surf Club, 61 Marine Parade, Coolangatta, QLD, 4225
events.description: THURSDAYS FROM 5PM  Deciding what to have for dinner can be tough…     But every Thursday, we’ve made it easy at Cooly Surf Club! Enjoy a juicy 300g Rump with chips, salad, and your choice of sauce for just $27 at our Thursday Night Steak Night!     Want to make it even better? Add creamy garlic prawns for just $7!    Available for members only. Not a member? Sign up at reception when you arrive. See you soon!

events.title: Market Night Raffles
events.location: Coolangatta Surf Club, 61 Marine Parade, Coolangatta, QLD, 4225
events.description: Thursdays from 5:30pm - 7pm    Tickets are $2 each and are on sale from 5:30pm.    Drawn at 7pm.    Prizes include meat trays, seafood trays and fruit trays.    T&Cs Apply. Must be present to win. Gamble Responsibly, Gambling Helpline 1800 858 858

events.title: Friday Raffles
events.location: Coolangatta Surf Club, 61 Marine Parade, Coolangatta, QLD, 4225
events.description: Every Friday from 5pm - 6pm     7 prizes to be won including meat, seafood and fruit trays. Tickets on sale from 5pm, drawn at 6pm.    T&C's Apply. Must be present to win. Gamble Responsibly, Gambling Helpline 1800 858 858

events.title: Saturday Raffles
events.description: Every Saturday from 12pm- 1:30pm    Join us every Saturday for our Saturday Raffles. All proceeds go directly to supporting our Surf Lifesavers!    Tickets are $2 and are on sale from 12pm.    Drawn at 1:30pm.    T&Cs Apply. Must be present to win. Please Gamble Responsibly.

events.title: Sunday Raffles
events.description: Every Sunday from 3pm-4pm      Sunday Raffles - 3 mega and 2 regular meat trays up for grabs. Tickets on sale from 3pm, drawn at 4pm.    T&Cs Apply. Must be present to win. Please Gamble Responsibly.
